title: Mark the cards a player surveilled into their graveyard this turn
clause: "You may play lands and cast spells from among cards in your graveyard you've surveilled this turn. If you cast a spell this way, you pay life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost." (Eye of Duskmantle)
why: The engine knows only that a PLAYER surveilled this turn (game/layers.go:411) and stamps where a graveyard card came FROM (zone.go stampGraveyardArrival), not that it arrived by this turn's surveil. Needs an additive per-card mark written on the surveil graveyard leg (zone_route.go:216 already names it) and cleared at the turn boundary, read by a standing cast/play permission. The life-for-mana-value alternative cost has precedents (valgavoth_terror_eater.go, gwenom_remorseless.go).
checked: grep -i 'surveilled' in game/: layers.go:411 (player-level), pending_choice.go:5826, events.go:470, zone_route.go:216; 'surveilled this turn' in effects: surveillance_phantasm.go, proctor_of_potential.go, desperate_futurescribe.go, all player-level conditions.
